info.title: Funded Hub API
info.description:
Contract v1 of the Funded Hub API, generated from the zod schemas in src/contracts. Never edit it by hand.

- Business endpoints live under /api/v1; JSON field names are snake_case, as the database columns.
- Success: `{ "data", "meta" }`; `meta` is `{}` for one item and `{ "next_cursor" }` for a list (cursor pagination: `limit` 1-100, default 20; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`).
- Error: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "fields" } }`; `code` comes from ErrorCode; `fields` appears only for VALIDATION_FAILED.
- Money and other decimals are strings (DecimalString); times are UTC ISO 8601 with "Z"; dates YYYY-MM-DD; IDs are UUIDs; enum values are the database enum labels.
- Response fields are always present (null when empty); new fields may be added within v1.
- Login uses the Supabase SDK; send its access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Admin endpoints also need MFA level aal2 (x-required-aal) and a permission (x-required-permission).

Records that the signed-in trader accepts this version. The server takes the IP address and user agent from the request itself, never from a body (there is none). Idempotent: accepting the same version again returns the existing acceptance with 200. Only the current published version of TERMS, PRIVACY or RISK_DISCLOSURE can be accepted here: an older version or a TRADER_AGREEMENT (accepted per trading account, later) answers 409 CONFLICT. This endpoint works before consent is complete, for the consent screen.

patch.summary: Update a program or change its status
patch.description:
Changes the fields sent. The slug stays unique (409). type changes only while DRAFT. Status changes: DRAFT to ACTIVE, ACTIVE to ARCHIVED, ARCHIVED to ACTIVE, DRAFT to ARCHIVED; never back to DRAFT. ACTIVE needs a complete program: phases matching the type (INSTANT: 1 FUNDED; ONE_STEP: 1 CHALLENGE, 2 FUNDED; TWO_STEP: 1 and 2 CHALLENGE, 3 FUNDED), every phase on a PUBLISHED rule set (a profit target for CHALLENGE phases, none for FUNDED), at least one active account size, and a payout policy. An ARCHIVED program accepts only a status change. A broken rule answers 409 CONFLICT with the reason.

Admin: Bearer token with MFA level aal2 (403 MFA_REQUIRED otherwise), an active admin member, and the permission `programs.manage` (403 FORBIDDEN otherwise).

patch.description:

Admin: Bearer token with MFA level aal2 (403 MFA_REQUIRED otherwise), an active admin member, and the permission `programs.manage` (403 FORBIDDEN otherwise).

DecimalString.description: A decimal number written as a JSON string, so no precision is lost: an optional minus sign, digits, and up to 8 decimals (for example "10000.00", "0.5" or "-5.5"). No exponent and no thousands separators. Each field states its unit and allowed range.

ErrorCode.description:
Machine-readable error code. Map it to text in the frontend.

- `BAD_REQUEST` (400): The request could not be read, for example malformed JSON.
- `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400): One or more inputs are invalid. `fields` maps each invalid field to one message; nested fields use dotted paths such as "instruments.2.instrument_id".
- `UNAUTHORIZED` (401): The access token is missing, invalid or expired. Refresh the Supabase session and retry.
- `FORBIDDEN` (403): Not allowed: the caller lacks the permission, is not an active admin member, or the trader profile is not ACTIVE.
- `MFA_REQUIRED` (403): Admin endpoints need MFA level aal2. Step up with the Supabase SDK (MFA challenge and verify), then retry with the new access token.
- `CONSENT_REQUIRED` (403): The current Terms and Privacy versions must be accepted first: GET /api/v1/me lists them in pending_agreements; accept each with POST /api/v1/agreements/{version_id}/accept.
- `COUNTRY_RESTRICTED` (403): Sign-up refused: the country is on the restricted list (Bybit's service-restricted countries). Sent by the sign-up check through Supabase Auth.
- `UNDER_AGE` (403): Sign-up refused: the date of birth shows the person is under the minimum age (18). Sent by the sign-up check through Supabase Auth.
- `NOT_FOUND` (404): The resource does not exist, or the caller may not see it.
- `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` (405): The HTTP method is not supported for this path.
- `CONFLICT` (409): The request conflicts with the current state, for example a duplicate slug, or a change the program's status does not allow. The message says which.
- `RULE_SET_PUBLISHED` (409): The rule set is PUBLISHED or RETIRED and can never change. Create a new version instead.
- `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (413): The request body is too large.
- `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` (415): The request body must be JSON (Content-Type: application/json).
- `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` (422): The server understood the request but cannot process it (HTTP 422 from the framework). Input validation uses VALIDATION_FAILED.
- `LOCKED` (423): The resource is locked.
- `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` (429): Rate limit reached. Wait before retrying.
- `HTTP_ERROR` (other 4xx): Any other HTTP 4xx error without a more specific code.
- `INTERNAL_ERROR` (500): Unexpected server error. Details are logged on the server and never sent to the client.
- `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` (503): A dependency is temporarily unavailable. Retry later.

ItemMeta.description: Metadata of a single-item response: an empty object in v1 (keys may be added).

next_cursor.description: Send it as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page.

max_allocation_per_trader_usd.description: Largest total funded allocation one trader may hold, USD. Allowed: greater than 0, at most 100000000, up to 2 decimals, or null.

country_code.description: Country of residence. Sign-up is refused (COUNTRY_RESTRICTED) for the countries in GET /api/v1/public/restricted-countries.

date_of_birth.description: Optional (ADR 0007 proposal; the age rule is still open). When sent, sign-up is refused (UNDER_AGE) if the person is younger than 18.

is_adult_declared.description: The person confirms they are at least 18 years old. Must be true.

terms_version_id.description: ID of the TERMS version shown on the form (GET /api/v1/public/agreements/TERMS/latest).

privacy_version_id.description: ID of the PRIVACY version shown on the form (GET /api/v1/public/agreements/PRIVACY/latest).

SignUpMetadata.description: What the frontend sends as `options.data` in supabase.auth.signUp. Unknown keys are refused. The sign-up check validates it and refuses with a SignUpRefusalCode. After the first login, the frontend records the acceptances with POST /api/v1/agreements/{version_id}/accept (the API records the IP address and user agent).

SignUpRefusalCode.description: Codes the sign-up check can refuse a sign-up with. They reach the app through supabase.auth.signUp as an AuthApiError: `status` is 400 (VALIDATION_FAILED) or 403, and `message` starts with the code and ": ", for example "COUNTRY_RESTRICTED: Sign-ups from your country are not available.". CONSENT_REQUIRED means the Terms or Privacy version on the form is no longer the current one: reload the form. If the message starts with no known code (for example a 500 "unexpected_failure"), show a generic error.

StaffMember.description: Staff membership of an existing Supabase profile. MFA is mandatory for all admin calls.

StaffRole.description: Seeded, read-only role and effective permission codes.

Timestamp.description: A date and time in UTC: ISO 8601 with a "Z" suffix, for example "2026-11-02T09:30:00Z". Fractional seconds may appear.

TraderRecord.description: Trader directory entry; excludes consent, signup IP and sensitive identity data.

consistency_pct.description: The best day may not exceed this percent of the total profit. Allowed: greater than 0, at most 100, up to 3 decimals, or null.

UpdateRuleSetBody.description: The fields to change (DRAFT versions only).
